scope: Epic #22 desktop WebGPU and WebGL implementation inventory; prerequisite probes are not browser API support

families.name: WebGPU discovery and device model
families.harness: Secure-context and V8 promise/exposure integration required

families.name: WebGPU resources and bindings
families.harness: WebGPU CTS browser bindings and resource validation required

families.name: WebGPU shaders and render pipelines
families.harness: WGSL compilation, offscreen pixel oracle and render-pass validation required

families.name: WebGPU canvas
families.harness: HTML canvas configuration and retained GPU image composition required

families.name: WebGPU asynchronous behavior
families.harness: Promise/task ordering, mapped backing-store lifetime and induced device loss required

families.name: WebGPU remaining command surface
families.harness: Compute, indirect execution, bundles and query CTS required

families.name: Adapter-dependent WebGPU features and limits
families.sourceOfTruth: Pinned WebGPU CTS and browser WebIDL/spec; enumerate individually during G09/G16 implementation
families.harness: Supported/unsupported feature negotiation, validation and limit boundaries required; native extensions are not automatically browser features

families.name: WebGL 1
families.harness: Khronos WebGL 1 runner, GLSL ES validation, typed-array overloads, context loss and browser state validation required

families.name: WebGL 2
families.harness: Khronos WebGL 2 runner, ES3 command/resource surface and WebGPU-to-WebGL application fallback fixture required

families.name: WebGL extensions
families.sourceOfTruth: Pinned Khronos WebGL extension specifications and tests; per-adapter filtering required
families.harness: WebGL extension exposure must not mirror the unrestricted ANGLE ES extension list

families.name: Canvas snapshots and serialization
families.harness: Call-time image capture, real PNG/Blob bytes, alpha/color conversion and origin-clean checks required

families.name: Worker execution and transferable canvases
families.harness: Worker event loop, structured clone/transfer, GPU ownership and resize ordering required

families.name: Image and video upload/import
families.harness: Source decoding, video lifetime, orientation/color space, premultiplication and security tests required
